evidence.scope: Actual computed observation on empty/add/clear operations and null receiver rejection; net9 uses method syntax and net10/net11 use C# 14 extension properties.

goal: Use a C# extension property for a cheap computed observation of an existing type. Retain method syntax for older targets or operations that behave like actions.

selectionNotes: Computed property only: no receiver storage, caching, synchronization or private-member access.
Import the extension namespace; existing applicable instance members take precedence.
This foundation uses C# 14 independently of C# 15 collection arguments and indexers.

constraints: The containing class is top-level, static and non-generic; put generic parameters on the extension block.
Use a named receiver and preserve null rejection; ambiguous namespaces require controlled imports.
Use method syntax for expensive work, actions or asynchronous operations.
